definitions.gloss: on a call; busy; in the middle of a phone call
definitions.explanation: The state of being engaged in a telephone conversation, or a phone line being in use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、{通話中|つうわちゅう}です。
examples.english: I'm on a call right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{通話中|つうわちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つながらない。
examples.english: No matter how many times I call, the line is busy and I can't get through.

examples.japanese: {通話中|つうわちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、いったん⟦{保留|ほりゅう}→保留：08364_horyuu⟧にして⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Another call came in while I was on the phone, so I put the first one on hold and answered it.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{通話|つうわ}→通話：14369_tsuuwa⟧ (telephone call/conversation) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in the middle of/during). Used both as a status indicator and in conversation to indicate someone is on the phone.

On older phones and landlines, calling a {通話中|つうわちゅう} number produces a busy signal ({話中音|わちゅうおん}). On smartphones, the term appears as a screen indicator during active calls. The ~⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ suffix is extremely productive and can attach to many nouns to mean "in the process of."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通話中|つうわちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: while on a call
- {通話中|つうわちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: in-call display
- {通話中|つうわちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つながらない: can't get through because the line is busy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {話中|わちゅう}: busy (phone line) — more technical, used in telecommunications
- ⟦{使用中|しようちゅう}→使用中：09554_shiyouchuu⟧: in use (broader, applies to anything being used)
- ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧: in a meeting
